note: Shelved — nothing consumes it. The 41 specs here were `single` conversions of the STATIC accessories (ears, hats, armguards); the animated characters themselves were never built, because Kenney's animation FBX retarget to a different bind pose (see CONTENT-MAP.md) and tosijs-3d uses the Quaternius rig instead. Now that derived/ IS the shipped tree, building these would publish them, so they are not built. `shelved` is what makes that stick: `bun run scan --write` skips this pack instead of silently regenerating the specs and putting the accessories back on the CDN. Delete this flag and re-scan to bring them back.
